sources.location: HTTP range read (first 3 MB) of 20161129_Homepacked20161011_15cm_JakobH_3.raw and 20170113_164744_ES804_15cm_Jakob_A_testIII.raw under https://ftp.pride.ebi.ac.uk/pride/data/archive/2022/05/PXD030998/

claims.value: 18 rows, one RAW per row, source = MaxQuant Experiment name (e.g. 7Inter_A_I)
claims.evidence: summary.txt maps each of the 18 RAW files to an Experiment name; 18 RAW in PRIDE file list (counted over all pages)
PRIDE title 'Samples from Paenibacillus amylolyticus'; paper Data Availability: PXD030998 is for P. amylolyticus (PXD031026 = X. retroflexus)

claims.value: Inter = co-cultivation with Xanthomonas retroflexus; Norm = single-species colony
claims.evidence: Paper: proteomics compares interacting vs non-interacting P. amylolyticus colonies at 48 h; Experiment names 7Inter_*/7Norm_* in summary.txt. Interpretation Inter=interacting, Norm=non-interacting is INFERRED from the names plus the paper's two-condition design (no deposited file defines the abbreviation). Supporting cross-check: Inter runs identify ~420-640 protein groups vs ~1450-2000 for Norm, consistent with the interaction colonies containing X. retroflexus protein absent from the P. amylolyticus search database
Paper: interacting and non-interacting colonies compared 'after 48 hrs of growth'
Whole bacterial colony biomass scraped from agar; PRIDE organism part 'biofilm' (BTO:0002690) is a submitter dropdown not used by the paper for these colonies, overridden

PLACEHOLDER numbering assigned by us in order (batch I then III, then letter A..E); the deposit does not say whether run letters A..E in batch I and III are the same or different biological samples. All rows technical replicate 1, fraction 1
RAW headers of both file groups: 'Q Exactive - Orbitrap MS', method 'Method of Q Exactive'; paper: Q-Exactive. PRIDE structured field says Q Exactive HF (MS:1002523): overridden
RAW method (both groups): '(N)CE nce: 25'. Paper states NCE 28%: conflict; raw wins by precedence
PRIDE data processing protocol (mqpar.xml not deposited)

PRIDE: 'incubated overnight by trypsin (1:100)'; deposited summary.txt shows search used Trypsin/P (MS:1001313); the digestion reagent named by the record (Trypsin) is written. reconcile flags cleavage_agent_unsupported as a false positive: its sentence-cue regex misses 'incubated overnight by trypsin'

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C fixed; Oxidation M and Acetyl protein N-term variable
claims.evidence: summary.txt lists variable Oxidation (M);Acetyl (Protein N-term); fixed Carbamidomethyl C taken from PRIDE data processing protocol since summary.txt has no fixed-modification column
Protocol: reduced with 5 mM DTT 1 h, alkylated with 20 mM iodoacetamide 1 h dark
Protocol: data dependent top 10; RAW method 'FULL MS / DD-MS2 (TOPN)'. All NT/AC terms resolved against live OLS4
MaxQuant LFQ, one RAW per sample, no fractionation described

limitations: Meaning of Inter/Norm is inferred from run names and the paper's interacting vs non-interacting design; no deposited file or sentence expands the abbreviations

Biological replicate integers are sequential placeholders; the relationship between batch I (2016-11-29) and batch III (2017-01-13) runs with the same letter is not stated in the paper, PRIDE record or deposited summary/proteinGroups; supplementary figures S16/S17 were not available to me
Collision energy 25 NCE (RAW method) conflicts with 28% in the paper and PRIDE protocol; raw followed
Instrument Q Exactive (RAW header, paper) overrides PRIDE structured Q Exactive HF
Cleavage agent written as Trypsin (digest reagent); deposited MaxQuant search used Trypsin/P
Fixed Carbamidomethyl comes from the PRIDE protocol text; deposited summary.txt does not list fixed modifications and mqpar.xml/parameters.txt are not deposited
Precursor/fragment tolerances from PRIDE text, not from a deposited parameter file
Organism part overridden from PRIDE 'biofilm' to not applicable; the paper does not call these proteomics colonies a biofilm
characteristics[treatment] values are free text and not in NCIT/EFO (validator warning only)
Sample type study sample PRIDE:0001013 triggers the known cache-only validator error; term valid in live OLS4
Search outputs summary.txt and proteinGroups.txt are not annotated as rows
Sample growth temperature, medium age and any other culture details beyond 50% TSA plates, 48 h were not annotated

RAW headers of ALL 18 files were verified by the independent reviewer: Q Exactive - Orbitrap MS, nce 25 in every file (the paper and PRIDE text say 28%); acquisition dates 2016-11-29 to 2016-12-03 (2016 group) and 2017-01-13 to 2017-01-17 (2017 group).

Condition is partly confounded with acquisition block: within the 2016 group the Norm runs were acquired 2016-11-29/30 and the Inter runs 2016-12-03; within the 2017 group the order is interleaved. The SDRF has no acquisition-date column.

Biological replicate integers are sequential placeholders; same-letter 2016-11 / 2017-01 runs could be re-runs of one sample (biological replicate 1-5 with technical replicate 2). Possible X. retroflexus carryover in the Inter colonies; material type `whole organism` is loose for scraped colony biomass.
